items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: He had Big Sid Catlett on drums, he had John Simmons on bass, he had Charlie Christian on guitar, and he had Fletcher Henderson on piano.

ctx.x: You have a very easy way of speaking. I like talking to you. See when Benny Goodman first started out with his band, 1935, he had Teddy Wilson with him and in 1936 Lionel Hampton. When he played certain places they didn’t want — he said this is my band, take me as it is. He may have said this I don’t know, but it’s like saying what you see is what you get. I mean he didn’t delete Lionel Hampton because he was black and he didn’t let Cootie Williams out because he was black and he didn’t leave Teddy Wilson out of…
That’s a real shame Charlie Christian didn’t last longer.
